select * from adi_knowledge_base
title like CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by update_time desc

select a.*, t.name as team_name from adi_knowledge_base a left join adi_team t on t.id = a.team_id
COALESCE(a.is_system, false) = false
and ( (COALESCE(a.owner_type, 'PERSONAL') = 'PERSONAL' and a.owner_id = #{ownerId}) or (a.owner_type = 'TEAM' and a.team_id in (select team_id from adi_team_member where user_id = #{ownerId})) or (a.owner_type = 'COMPANY' and (a.company_scope = 'STAFF' or #{isAdmin})) )
and a.owner_id = #{ownerId} and COALESCE(a.owner_type, 'PERSONAL') = 'PERSONAL'
and a.title like CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by a.star_count desc,a.update_time desc

select a.*, t.uuid as team_uuid, t.name as team_name, m.role as my_role from adi_knowledge_base a inner join adi_team_member m on m.team_id = a.team_id and m.user_id = #{userId} left join adi_team t on t.id = a.team_id
COALESCE(a.is_system, false) = false and a.owner_type = 'TEAM'
and a.title like CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by a.update_time desc
select a.* from adi_knowledge_base a inner join adi_knowledge_base_item b on a.id = b.kb_id where b.uuid = #{itemUuid}
mapper.update: update adi_knowledge_base set route_profile_generation = route_profile_generation + 1, route_profile_status = 'STALE', route_profile_source_hash = '', route_profile_status_change_time = current_timestamp where uuid = #{kbUuid}

update adi_knowledge_base set route_profile_status = 'READY', route_profile_active_generation = #{generation}, route_profile_set_uuid = #{profileSetUuid}, route_profile_source_hash = #{sourceHash}, route_profile_model_id = #{modelId}, route_profile_model_identity = #{modelIdentity}, route_profile_status_change_time = current_timestamp where uuid = #{kbUuid} and route_profile_generation = #{generation}
